XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadically when the brake is pressed, the front left and rear right wheels brake.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ABS | GROUP | ANTI | LOCK | SYSTEM | REMAINS | BRAKING | BRAKED | LEFT | LEFT | RIGHT | RIGHT | TYRE | WHEEL | REMAIN | BRAKED |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ABS

  • Device: ABS hydraulic unit

  • Fault: When the brake pedal is pressed, the vehicle maintains braking on the front left wheel and rear right wheel. The lock-up persists for a few moments.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty ABS hydraulic unit solenoid valves

• Action: Check that the ABS hydraulic unit components are working properly and replace them if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the fault was permanently resolved after replacing the ABS hydraulic unit.
    The component is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side near the passenger compartment.
